##### Project general facts

Mandarin Oriental Residences is an exclusive branded collection created by Aldar in collaboration with the world-renowned Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group. Two elegant buildings, each rising from a ground floor to nine residential floors, feature light facades, natural materials and flowing lines that radiate calm and harmony, with the warmth of wood complemented by metallic accents. The collection ranges from one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom residences to five-bedroom penthouses, offering views of landmark museums.

Amenities reflect the legendary hospitality of the brand. Residents enjoy opulent hotel-style lobbies, residents' lounges and private dining rooms, together with indoor and outdoor pools, kids' pools, indoor gyms, fitness studios, squash courts and spas. Male and female salons, communal working spaces, conference rooms, cinemas, game rooms, indoor kids' clubs and pet grooming rooms complete the offer, while a dedicated concierge, housekeeping and round-the-clock security deliver a seamless five-star lifestyle.

Homes are delivered fully furnished, with interiors curated by the renowned interior designer Lillian Wu. Rich, earthy woods create an intimate and inviting ambiance, while natural materials and organic contours offer timeless appeal and metal accents add a modern touch. Spacious living areas, refined bedrooms and elegant bathrooms are designed for comfort. A la carte services include private dining and catering, tailored home design, private chefs, travel planning, private yoga and meditation classes, luxury transportation and children's programmes.

##### Location description and benefits

The Saadiyat Cultural District is the heart of culture in Abu Dhabi, home to Zayed National Museum, Louvre Abu Dhabi, Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, the Abrahamic Family House, teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi and the Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi. The district combines world-class institutions with calm residential neighbourhoods, landscaped promenades and pristine beaches along the coastline of Saadiyat Island, creating a refined setting for everyday life.

Zayed National Museum is within walking distance, and Mamsha Al Saadiyat, Saadiyat Beach, Saadiyat Beach Golf Club and NYU Abu Dhabi are only a short drive away. Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway connects the island with Al Reem Island, Al Maryah Island, the city centre, Yas Island and Zayed International Airport, while premium schools, fine dining venues and shopping destinations are found across the island.

Saadiyat Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious addresses in the UAE. Branded residences of an internationally recognised hotel group at the heart of the cultural district are in very limited supply, supporting strong demand from high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants. The cultural offer, beaches and connectivity underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects.
